name: Maltodextrin
aliases: maltodextrin, maltodextrina, maltodextrine, hydrogenated starch hydrolysate
what_is: An ultra-processed carbohydrate powder made from the partial breakdown of starches.
why_botia: It flags it because it is a rapid-acting sugar substitute and a clear marker of ultra-processing (NOVA Group 4) that affects blood glucose.
can_1: Detect maltodextrin and classify the food as ultra-processed (NOVA 4).
can_2: Trigger a Sugar layer warning for glycemic management.
cannot_1: Determine the botanical starch source (e.g., corn, wheat, or tapioca) unless explicitly declared.
cannot_2: Ascertain the glycemic index or the molecular chain length of the specific maltodextrin used.
title: Maltodextrin
description: An ultra-processed carbohydrate powder made from the partial breakdown of starches.
